summary: Yalcouyé is out for six to 10 weeks, but he was a substitute, not a starter: Groß, Gómez, Ayari and Andrés have started every league game. Hinshelwood moves up to first midfield substitute and is predicted to start the Conference League tie on Thursday. A league start against Newcastle on Sunday is unlikely unless Brighton rotate.

claims.text: Came on for Ayari at Hull; rated 4.75 and 'could not replicate the energy' of the man he replaced.

claims.text: Hurzeler: knee injury from Ivory Coast duty, out for six to 10 weeks.

claims.text: Predicted to start in the No 10 role against Craiova in the Conference League on Thursday, with Gómez possibly rested.
